defense_news.title: UNIFIL’s final months: Uncertainty persists in Lebanon over what comes next
defense_news.summary: The mission for the United Nations Interim Force in Lebanon is nearing its end. Amid Israeli occupation, a decision on what comes next has yet to be made.

defense_news.title: Just one in three Americans back Iran war, most unsure of Trump’s goals, poll finds
defense_news.summary: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found that 69% of Americans think President Donald Trump has not “clearly explained the goals of U.S. military involvement in Iran.”

defense_news.title: Chinese military researchers tap US AI models to train defense systems
defense_news.summary: Chinese researchers have reportedly used leading U.S. AI models developed by OpenAI and Anthropic to train AI systems to advance defense capabilities.

defense_news.title: The arms race for cheaper anti-ballistic weapons is underway
defense_news.summary: After years of a Patriot monopoly, new anti-ballistic alternatives are emerging. Officials hope to see some of them on the battlefield by the end of 2026.

geo_news.title: Üniversite tercih festivali TercihFest'26 zirve konuşmalarıyla devam etti
geo_news.summary: İbn Haldun Üniversitesi (İHÜ) tarafından bu yıl dokuzuncusu düzenlenen üniversite tercih festivali TercihFest'26, zirve konuşmaları ile devam etti.
